wiki_overview.content:
<blog>

# Notification Log - Android Notification Capture Application

## Project Introduction

### Purpose Statement
Notification Log is an Android application designed to capture, store, and display system notifications from all apps on a device. The application provides real-time monitoring of incoming notifications while maintaining a persistent record for later analysis and review.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Real-time Notification Capture**: Monitor and capture notifications as they arrive from any application
- **Persistent Storage**: Store captured notifications locally using Room database for offline access
- **User-Friendly Interface**: Provide an intuitive interface for viewing, sorting, and managing captured notifications
- **Background Operation**: Maintain notification capture functionality even when the app is not actively in focus
- **Export Capabilities**: Allow users to export notification logs in multiple formats for analysis

### Target Audience
- Privacy-conscious users who want to monitor what notifications their apps are sending
- Developers debugging notification-related issues
- Users investigating suspicious or unwanted notifications
- Anyone requiring notification audit trails for personal or professional purposes

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern Android architecture pattern with clear separation of concerns:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[MainActivity] --> B[MainViewModel]
    B --> C[NotificationRepository]
    C --> D[NotificationDatabase]
    D --> E[NotificationDao]
    F[NotificationListener] --> C
    G[NotificationAdapter] --> A
    H[NotificationItem] --> D
    
    style A fill:#e1f5fe
    style B fill:#f3e5f5
    style C fill:#e8f5e8
    style D fill:#fff3e0
```

### Component Breakdown

**Presentation Layer**
- `MainActivity`: Primary UI controller handling user interactions and displaying notification lists
- `NotificationAdapter`: RecyclerView adapter for efficient list rendering with diffing capabilities
- `MainViewModel`: State management and business logic coordination

**Data Layer**
- `NotificationRepository`: Data access abstraction layer
- `NotificationDatabase`: Room database definition
- `NotificationDao`: Data access operations
- `NotificationItem`: Entity model representing notification data

**Service Layer**
- `NotificationListener`: Background service for capturing notifications in real-time

### Design Patterns

The application implements several key design patterns:

- **MVVM Pattern**: Clean separation between UI, business logic, and data layers
- **Repository Pattern**: Abstracts data access operations behind a unified interface
- **Observer Pattern**: Uses LiveData for reactive UI updates
- **Singleton Pattern**: Application-level database initialization through NotificationApp

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant MainActivity
    participant NotificationListener
    participant Repository
    participant Database
    
    User->>MainActivity: Enable notification capture
    MainActivity->>NotificationListener: Start service
    NotificationListener->>Repository: Insert notification
    Repository->>Database: Save to room database
    Database-->>Repository: Confirmation
    Repository-->>MainActivity: Update LiveData
    MainActivity-->>User: Display notification in list
```

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Application Initialization**
- `NotificationApp.kt`: Application class handling global initialization of Room database and repository

**Primary UI Controller**
- `MainActivity.kt`: Main activity managing user interface, permissions, and notification display

**Background Service**
- `NotificationListener.kt`: NotificationListenerService for capturing notifications in real-time

### Core Modules

**Data Model**
- `NotificationItem.kt`: Room entity representing notification data with primary key, app identifiers, and timestamps

**Data Access**
- `NotificationDatabase.kt`: Room database definition with DAO interface
- `NotificationDao.kt`: Database operations for CRUD operations and sorting

**Repository Layer**
- `NotificationRepository.kt`: Business logic layer abstracting database operations

**UI Components**
- `NotificationAdapter.kt`: RecyclerView adapter with DiffUtil for efficient list updates

### Configuration Approach

**Android Manifest Configuration**
- Service declaration for NotificationListenerService
- Required permissions for notification access and internet connectivity
- Application-level configuration including theme and icon settings

**Room Database Setup**
- Single-table database schema optimized for notification storage
- Automatic migration support for future schema changes

### External Dependencies

**Core Dependencies**
- AndroidX Room for local database persistence
- AndroidX Lifecycle components for MVVM architecture
- Material Design components for modern UI
- Kotlin Coroutines for asynchronous operations

**Integration Points**
- Android NotificationListenerService API for capturing system notifications
- Android SharedPreferences for user preference storage
- MediaStore API for exporting notification logs as screenshots or text files

### Component Relationship Diagram

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class NotificationApp {
        +repository: NotificationRepository
        +onCreate()
    }
    
    class MainActivity {
        +binding: ActivityMainBinding
        +viewModel: MainViewModel
        +adapter: NotificationAdapter
        +checkPermissions()
        +saveScreenshot()
        +saveTextLog()
    }
    
    class MainViewModel {
        +serviceStatus: LiveData~Boolean~
        +notifications: LiveData~List~
        +loadNotifications()
        +deleteNotification()
        +clearNotifications()
    }
    
    class NotificationListener {
        +onNotificationPosted()
        +onNotificationRemoved()
        +showAccessRevokedNotification()
    }
    
    class NotificationRepository {
        +getAllNotifications()
        +insert()
        +delete()
        +deleteAll()
    }
    
    class NotificationDatabase {
        +notificationDao(): NotificationDao
    }
    
    class NotificationItem {
        +id: Long
        +packageName: String
        +appName: String
        +title: String
        +content: String
        +timestamp: Long
    }
    
    NotificationApp --> NotificationRepository
    MainActivity --> MainViewModel
    MainViewModel --> NotificationRepository
    NotificationListener --> NotificationRepository
    NotificationRepository --> NotificationDatabase
    NotificationDatabase --> NotificationItem
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Real-time Notification Capture**
- Continuous monitoring of system notifications through NotificationListenerService
- Automatic capture of notification metadata including app name, title, and content
- Timestamp tracking for chronological organization

**Local Storage and Management**
- SQLite-based storage through Room database for offline accessibility
- Support for sorting notifications by date or application
- Ability to delete individual notifications or clear entire history

**User Interface Features**
- Dark/light theme support with persistent preference storage
- Screenshot capture of current notification list
- Export functionality for creating text logs of notification history
- Persistent notification showing active capture status

### Implementation Highlights

**Background Operation**
- `NotificationListener.kt`: Handles notification capture without user interaction
- Real-time updates through broadcast receivers and LiveData observers

**Data Persistence**
- `NotificationDatabase.kt`: Structured database schema optimized for notification queries
- Efficient querying with multiple sort options for different user needs

**User Experience**
- `MainActivity.kt`: Comprehensive UI with permission handling and error management
- `NotificationAdapter.kt`: Optimized list rendering with smooth scrolling and item animations

### Feature Architecture Diagram

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Initializing
    Initializing --> CheckingPermissions: App start
    CheckingPermissions --> WaitingForUser: Permission required
    CheckingPermissions --> Ready: Permissions granted
    WaitingForUser --> Ready: User grants permission
    Ready --> Capturing: User enables capture
    Capturing --> Stopped: User disables capture
    Stopped --> Capturing: User re-enables capture
    Capturing --> Error: Permission lost
    Error --> WaitingForUser: User resolves issue
    Ready --> [*]: App exit
    Stopped --> [*]: App exit
    Error --> [*]: App exit
```

**Notification Capture Flow**
- Real-time monitoring through NotificationListenerService
- Automatic database insertion via Repository pattern
- Live UI updates through ViewModel and LiveData
- Background operation with persistent notification status

**Export and Storage Features**
- Screenshot capture using Android's drawing capabilities
- Text log generation with timestamp formatting
- MediaStore integration for cross-platform compatibility
- Preference-based configuration for user customization

---

**Sources:**
- [NotificationApp.kt](app/src/main/java/com/notificationlog/NotificationApp.kt)
- [MainActivity.kt](app/src/main/java/com/notificationlog/MainActivity.kt)
- [MainViewModel.kt](app/src/main/java/com/notificationlog/MainViewModel.kt)
- [NotificationListener.kt](app/src/main/java/com/notificationlog/NotificationListener.kt)
- [NotificationItem.kt](app/src/main/java/com/notificationlog/model/NotificationItem.kt)
- [NotificationDatabase.kt](app/src/main/java/com/notificationlog/data/NotificationDatabase.kt)
- [NotificationDao.kt](app/src/main/java/com/notificationlog/data/NotificationDao.kt)
- [NotificationRepository.kt](app/src/main/java/com/notificationlog/repository/NotificationRepository.kt)
- [NotificationAdapter.kt](app/src/main/java/com/notificationlog/adapter/NotificationAdapter.kt)
- [AndroidManifest.xml](app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml)

</blog>
